_readme: Media backend contract. The installer copies this file to ~/.config/opencode/media/backends.json when no config exists yet. Edit that copy (never this template) and replace every <angle-bracket> token with a real command and flag your machine provides. Each operation is an argv array; the media agents substitute the named placeholders and execute it through their permission layer. No provider is assumed by this repo.

image.notes: Optional: document whether this backend accepts local paths or requires a URL for {image}.

video.notes: Optional: add {image} / {last_frame} / {duration} / {resolution} entries your backend supports. Omit "status" only when generate blocks until the file exists.

tts.notes: Optional: document how the user lists available voices.

asr.notes: Optional: document supported formats, duration limits, and whether local paths or URLs are accepted.
